description: SHA-256 Manifest of frozen experimental datasets, splits, and models for MM-RAG Addendum Study

ai_engine/rag/data/v2/public_benchmark_v.description: Public multimodal corpus (1,626 items: 626 SROIE + 1,000 COCO) and 612 factual probes split 50/50

ai_engine/rag/data/v2/frozen_probes_with.description: Frozen 612 probes with verbatim, light paraphrase (mean overlap 41.2%), and heavy paraphrase (mean overlap 0.1%)

ai_engine/rag/data/v2/paraphrase_audit_s.description: 10% random sample (61 rows) of paraphrased probes for audit and inspection

ai_engine/rag/data/v2/sroie_degraded_ocr.description: Apple Vision OCR applied to physical images degraded by Gaussian blur (r=1.5), 50% downscale, +/-4 deg rotation, JPEG Q20 (Mean CER: 0.5218, Mean WER: 0.7561)
